# EchoDiar

> EchoDiar is a free, open-source, local-first meeting recorder for macOS (Apple Silicon) that transcribes meetings, tells speakers apart, and lets you ask AI about them.

EchoDiar is a native Swift menu bar app. It records one app's audio (Zoom, Teams, Meet in a browser...) or all system audio, plus your microphone, on separate channels. Transcription runs on-device with WhisperKit, Parakeet, Qwen3-ASR or Apple Speech (macOS 26), with FluidAudio speaker diarization, or optionally with cloud speech-to-text services. With WhisperKit or Parakeet, EchoDiar transcribes while you record (the live captions come from the same model), so the transcript is ready seconds after you stop. AI summaries and chat work with on-device models (MLX, Apple Foundation Models on macOS 26), local servers (LM Studio, Ollama, Jan, llama.cpp, vLLM), cloud APIs with your own key, or subscription CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI). Licensed AGPLv3.
